Specifically, we want to ensure that the VHAP content can be reasonably expected never to exceed 10.0 percent by weight. Can you provide guidance on this matter?

adi-M080005.question: We operate an iron and steel foundry in Indiana and have experienced furnace malfunctions and labor strikes that have delayed our initial performance testing. Our Phase 1 melting process and other foundry processes are subject to the National Emission Standards for Hazardous Air Pollutants. Can we consider these events as force majeure to extend our compliance testing deadline?

adi-M080020.question: We operate a cellulose food casing facility in Illinois and would like to replace one of our GC/PID instruments with a new Baseline-MOCON Model 8900 to measure hydrogen sulfide and carbon disulfide. Can we modify our alternative monitoring plan to accommodate the calibration differences of this new instrument?

adi-M080034.question: We operate a facility in Illinois that includes two argon stir stations. We are required to test particulate emissions from these stations, but we believe that testing is impractical due to the influence of emissions from a baghouse that also controls emissions from a ladle metallurgical furnace. Can we obtain a waiver for this testing requirement under the relevant regulations?

adi-M100004.question: We operate a facility that produces hydrochloric acid and utilizes an Irgafos V-47 caustic scrubber in McIntosh, Alabama. We are seeking approval for alternative operating parameters for our scrubber, specifically a minimum recirculation flow rate of 65 gallons per minute and a scrubbing liquid concentration of at least 2% by weight caustic. Can we receive approval for these alternative parameters under the relevant regulations?

adi-M100014.question: We operate a bulk gasoline terminal in Colorado Springs, Colorado, and are seeking approval for an alternative monitoring method for our vapor combustion unit. Specifically, we want to monitor the continuous presence of a pilot flame instead of temperature monitoring at the firebox. Our facility handles gasoline and has intermittent loading operations, and we believe this alternative method is necessary due to operational costs and emissions concerns.

adi-M100018.question: We operate a facility in South Carolina that uses hydrochloric acid (HCl) bubbler control devices to manage HCl emissions. We would like to set alternate operating limits for these devices, including a minimum dipleg immersion depth and maximum time between liquid change outs. Can we receive approval for these alternative monitoring requirements?

adi-M110005.question: We operate a facility that includes ten emission units and utilizes a permanent total enclosure (PTE) for compliance with air quality standards. We are seeking approval for an alternative monitoring method to replace the requirement for measuring facial velocity through natural draft openings with static pressure measurements from the duct to our regenerative thermal oxidizer (RTO). Our facility is located in Ohio, and we want to ensure we can demonstrate continuous compliance with the applicable regulations.

adi-M120007.question: We operate a natural gas processing plant in Texas and use a mixture of ethylene glycol and water in our cooling jacket water service. We would like to know if we can conduct quarterly visual inspections of our ancillary equipment instead of using EPA Reference Method 21 for leak detection. Our facility operates in VHAP service and has equipment leak standards that we need to comply with.

adi-M150036.question: We operate an asphalt roofing manufacturing facility in Oregon and are planning to conduct an initial performance test. Can we receive a waiver for the 60-day advance notification requirement to allow testing during our highest volume period?

adi-M150038.question: We operate a chrome plating facility in Connecticut and are planning to install three enclosed hard chromium plating tanks equipped with Palm Technology Emission Eliminating Devices. We would like to know if we can use alternative monitoring procedures to demonstrate compliance with the operation and maintenance practices specified in the regulations, as the standard methods are not feasible for our equipment. Can we receive approval for these alternative procedures?

adi-M170016.question: We operate a synthetic organic chemical manufacturing facility with a heat exchange system in Louisiana. We are seeking approval for an alternative monitoring plan that proposes a different sampling technique than what is specified under the National Emission Standards for Hazardous Air Pollutants. Can we use composite sample collection instead of the required grab samples?

adi-M170025.question: We operate a paste production plant in Indiana and are in the process of restarting a smelter that was idled on March 31, 2016. We are requesting an additional 60 days to install a carbon adsorber system necessary to meet the required POM removal rate at our pitch storage tank. Can we receive an extension for the compliance date of October 16, 2017?
